title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension and chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease and hypertension. He reports feeling well today with no acute complaints of edema, shortness of breath, or significant fatigue. He remains compliant with his current antihypertensive regimen and reports regular monitoring of his blood pressure at home. He denies any recent changes in urinary output or significant fluctuations in weight.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable with blood pressure recorded at 132/84 mmHg. Physical exam reveals no pedal edema and clear breath sounds. Skin is warm and dry. No new neurological deficits noted.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. The patient will continue to monitor blood pressure and report any significant changes. Follow-up in three months for a repeat laboratory evaluation of renal function and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
